a_to_empty_rate = k_a_to_empty*a_concentration
a_to_a_rate = k_a_to_a_cell*a_concentration
a_to_b_rate = k_a_to_b_cell*a_concentration
b_to_empty_rate = k_b_to_empty*b_concentration
b_to_a_rate = k_b_to_a_cell*b_concentration
aa_cell_resolvent = laplace_rate + k_a_from_aa_cell
a_cell_effective_resolvent = laplace_rate + k_a_from_a_cell + a_to_a_rate + b_to_a_rate - k_a_from_aa_cell*a_to_a_rate/aa_cell_resolvent
b_cell_resolvent = laplace_rate + k_b_from_b_cell + a_to_b_rate
ab_cell_resolvent = laplace_rate + k_b_from_ab_cell + k_a_from_ab_cell + k_product_formation
ab_to_empty_ratio = (b_to_a_rate*a_to_empty_rate/a_cell_effective_resolvent + a_to_b_rate*b_to_empty_rate/b_cell_resolvent)/(ab_cell_resolvent - b_to_a_rate*k_b_from_ab_cell/a_cell_effective_resolvent - a_to_b_rate*k_a_from_ab_cell/b_cell_resolvent)
a_to_empty_ratio = (a_to_empty_rate + k_b_from_ab_cell*ab_to_empty_ratio)/a_cell_effective_resolvent
b_to_empty_ratio = (b_to_empty_rate + k_a_from_ab_cell*ab_to_empty_ratio)/b_cell_resolvent
aa_to_empty_ratio = a_to_a_rate*a_to_empty_ratio/aa_cell_resolvent
empty_cell_transform = 1/(laplace_rate + a_to_empty_rate + b_to_empty_rate - k_a_from_a_cell*a_to_empty_ratio - k_b_from_b_cell*b_to_empty_ratio - k_product_formation*ab_to_empty_ratio)
a_cell_transform = a_to_empty_ratio*empty_cell_transform
b_cell_transform = b_to_empty_ratio*empty_cell_transform
aa_cell_transform = aa_to_empty_ratio*empty_cell_transform
ab_cell_transform = ab_to_empty_ratio*empty_cell_transform
product_pulse_transform = k_product_formation*ab_cell_transform
response = cell_capacity*laplace_rate*product_pulse_transform

usage_details.scope: Selected discovery invocation plus each latest evaluated probe; excludes superseded failed attempts. Not the total spend of all retries.
usage_details.token_semantics: input includes cached input; total=input+output; reason is a subset of output. null means unrecorded. Incomplete usage is a recorded lower bound.
usage_details.cost_note: Unknown costs remain null; no pricing estimates or zero-cost assumptions.
